   - Selected mode "经典接鱼挑战模式": cat moves left/right at screen bottom catching falling fish (gold fish worth more); trash mixed in deducts points and briefly slows movement; fall speed and density increase over time; 60-second round with score settlement; missing normal fish doesn't end the game but missing many fish affects bonus score.
   - Scope (first complete playable): 1 cat, 3 fish types, 2 trash types, 1 sixty-second level, basic scoring + result/settlement screen, warm lively BGM and SFX.
   - Settings: platform Web, engine React, Cartoon style, 2D, Arcade, inputs Touch + Keyboard/mouse, Landscape orientation, resource library usage optional.
   - Process instructions (verbatim intent): Plan and execute autonomously; do not wait for BGS milestones or host Task plan.
